newsitem.title: USA: Avid see Q4 charge $4-$6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Avid see Q4 charge $4-$6 mln.

text.p: Avid Technology Inc said it will incur a non-cash inventory charge, which is expected to be in the range of $4 million to $6 million, in the fourth quarter.
It decided on the charge after an extensive review of its worldwide inventories.
It said the charge will relate principally to spare parts that are no longer required to support the company's business.

"We are continuing to place a high priority on improving cash flow through more effective asset utilization," said William Flaherty, Avid chief finanical officer. "This inventory charge reflects a companywide effort to establish inventory levels that are sufficient to meet customer service needs, while at the same time do not entail unnecessary carrying costs."

Avid develops and supplies all-digital solutions for capturing, creating, editing and distributing digital media on multiple platforms. Avid's product line encompasses nonlinear film, video and audio editing, special effects and image processing software.
